ReduceMotion.Name: Reduce Motion
ReduceMotion.Hint: Reduce or disable HUD animations for motion-sensitive users. Applies only to your client.

DisableHitFeedback.Name: Disable Hit Feedback
DisableHitFeedback.Hint: Disable the card flash animation that plays when attribute values change (e.g. HP change, status applied).

TooltipPosition.Name: Tooltip Position Mode
TooltipPosition.Hint: Choose how the action menu tooltip is positioned. Applies only to your client.

TooltipSide.Name: Preferred Tooltip Side
TooltipSide.Hint: Choose which side of an Action Menu item or the cursor the tooltip prefers. It switches sides when needed to stay on screen. Applies only to your client.

ActionMenuSubmenuSide.Name: Action Menu Submenu Side
ActionMenuSubmenuSide.Hint: Choose which side of the Action HUD submenus open on. Automatic uses the available screen space. Applies only to your client.

ActionMenuSubmenuWidth.Name: Action Menu Submenu Width
ActionMenuSubmenuWidth.Hint: Adjust submenu width in pixels. 350 preserves each theme's original width; higher values expand away from the main menu. Applies only to your client.

VoiceIndicator.Name: Voice Activity Indicator
VoiceIndicator.Hint: Highlight the HUD card of a speaking player with a glow effect. Requires microphone permission from each player's browser.

VoiceIndicatorColor.Name: My Voice Indicator Color
VoiceIndicatorColor.Hint: Choose your personal glow color for the voice activity indicator. Other players will see this color when you speak.

Tracking.Title: Tracked Attributes
Tracking.QualitativeDisplay: Qualitative (non-owners see Healthy/Wounded/etc. instead of numbers)
Tracking.ThresholdMarkers: Show threshold markers on the bar
Tracking.SegmentedBar: Combine this bar with a linked resource
Tracking.ThresholdStagesNote: Stages control threshold colors and marker positions. Markers at 0% and 100% are not drawn.
Tracking.LinkedBarNote: The linked resource must be a decreasing pool with an integer maximum from 2 to 20. If it cannot be resolved, the bar is shown normally.
Tracking.CompactIconOnly: Compact: show icon + value only (hide label, needs an icon)
Tracking.HitFeedback: Trigger hit feedback (card flash) only when this attribute changes

Actor.DisplayNameHint: Override the actor name shown on the Party HUD and Action Menu.

Rules.Title: Dynamic Image Rules (Conditions)
Rules.Empty: No active rules. Click 'Add Rule' to start.
Rules.TooltipSpeakingImg: Optional. While this rule is active, this image is used when the actor is speaking. Falls back to the active portrait variant's speaking image, then the legacy voice variant.

Style.ThemeNote: Applies to both Party HUD and Action Menu.
Style.FontNote: Custom fonts for HUD text. Select (Theme Default) to use the theme's default font.
Style.ActionMenuFontNote: Custom font for the Action Menu. Select (Theme Default) to use the theme's default font.
Style.EmphasizeFirstActionButtonNote: Turn this off to give the first button the same size and style as the other category buttons.
Style.Dnd5eGroupActionsByActivationNote: In the D&D5e Features menu, split action features into separate left-sidebar tabs by activation type (Action, Bonus, Reaction, etc.). Off keeps the single Actions tab.
Style.Pf2eMergeActionsAndFeatsNote: Show PF2e action items and active feats together in the Actions menu, and hide the separate Feats button.
Style.ActionMenuNote: Show floating action buttons when a token is selected.
Style.PanToTokenOnClick: Pan Camera to Token on Card Click
Style.PanToTokenOnClickNote: If disabled, clicking a Party HUD card still selects the token but does not move the camera. Disable this when using a fixed-camera module.
Style.OwnerOnlyCardsNote: Only show HUD cards to the character's owner and observers. GM always sees all.
Style.SceneFriendlyNPCsNote: Automatically show HUD cards for linked NPCs with Friendly disposition on the current scene. Cards update when scenes change or tokens are added/removed.
Style.OnlinePlayersOnlyNote: Only show cards for characters whose player is currently online. NPCs in the roster are always visible.
Style.UseTokenName: Use token name on cards (instead of actor name)
Style.UseTokenNameNote: When a card has no name override, show the actor's token name instead of the actor name.
Style.DisplayModeNote: When set to 'Selected Token Only', cards appear only when the corresponding token is selected. Falls back to owned characters when nothing is selected.
Style.HudBehindUINote: Display HUD behind Foundry core UI elements (sidebar, hotbar, etc.)
Style.CollapseCardsNote: Collapse cards to portrait-only thumbnails. Hover to expand. (Shift+C to toggle live)
Style.ThemeGMWarning: Only the GM can manage themes.
Style.NoLayers: No layers added. Click 'Add Layer' to create one.
Style.PortraitLayersNote: Add multiple image layers around the portrait. Z-Index controls stacking (Portrait=5). Layers with higher Z appear on top.
Style.CardBgLayersNote: Add multiple image layers behind the card. Z-Index controls stacking. Layers with higher Z appear on top.
Style.ElementImageNote: Default images for bars, dots, and numbers. Per-attribute overrides in Tracking tab.
Style.CardSizeNote: Default size for all cards. Can be overridden per actor.
Style.CardScaleNote: Scale the entire card (e.g., 0.7 for a familiar). Leave at 1.0 for default.
Style.ReduceMotionNote: Disable animations for users sensitive to motion (respects system preference)

Effects.Title: Status Effects (Global)
Effects.StatusIDNote: Select from list or type custom ID (e.g. 'dead', 'prone')

Menu.Explanation: Drag and drop items or macros to build your custom menu.
Menu.WorkflowNote: This tab defines the shared menu structure stored at the World level (visibility filters can still limit which categories or tabs each actor sees). To add actions or macros for one specific character, close this window, select that actor or token, then drag items/macros into its Action Menu as Personal entries.

Menu.LivePreviewHint: Changes appear immediately. Click or hover a button to test its sound.

Menu.OptionalColorHint: Double-click to use the theme color.
Menu.SoundPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the global or theme sound
